objectives.description: Confirm scope hypothesis: corpus size via git ls-files count
Capture sequential baseline (idle) finding set + timing
Implement one-process-per-file worker pool dispatch in lint-shellcheck.sh with header rationale
Choose worker cap via fresh experiment run, not bare nproc
Add repeatable acceptance test suite test-lint-shellcheck-parallel.sh and register it load-sensitive in run-all.sh
Prove finding-set equivalence sequential vs parallel incl. seeded violation, verified against the pre-change original via a throwaway worktree
Verify discovery-order determinism, Gate 22 exit status, and the broader regression net

approaches_tried.approach: xargs -P N -n1 timing experiment to pick worker cap
